","rock0":"","rock1":"","rock2":"","barrier0":"","barrier1":""};
 const environmentModels={};try{for(const [kind,blob] of Object.entries(ENVIRONMENT_GLB))environmentModels[kind]=loadGLB(blob,'environment');}catch(err){console.error('Рубеж окружение GLB:',err);}
 // v10.0: asset pipeline, not a graphical substitute for professional 3D art.
 // User-selected GLBs override only environment meshes in this session. No files are uploaded anywhere.
 const ENV_NAMES=['pine0','pine1','pine2','oak','rock0','rock1','rock2','barrier0','barrier1'];
 const envInput=el('envAssetInput'),envStatus=el('envAssetStatus');
 envInput.addEventListener('change',async()=>{
   const files=Array.from(envInput.files||[]);if(!files.length)return;
   let ok=0,errors=[];
   for(const file of files){
      const stem=file.name.replace(/\.glb$/i,'').toLowerCase();
      // Supported: pine0.glb, environment_pine0.glb or Rubezh_Environment_Pine0_v9_9.glb.
      const key=ENV_NAMES.find(n=>stem===n||stem==='environment_'+n||stem.endsWith('_'+n)||stem.includes('_'+n+'_'));
      if(!key){errors.push(file.name+': имя не соответствует каталогу');continue;}
      if(file.size>24*1024*1024){errors.push(file.name+': превышен лимит 24 МБ');continue;}
      try{
        const dataURL=await new Promise((resolve,reject)=>{const rd=new FileReader();rd.onload=()=>resolve(String(rd.result));rd.onerror=()=>reject(Error('Ошибка чтения'));rd.readAsDataURL(file);});
        const replacement=loadGLB(dataURL.split(',')[1],'environment');
        if(!replacement?.some(p=>p?.count>0)){errors.push(file.name+': в GLB нет видимой геометрии');continue;}
        // Old GPU buffers are freed after a complete replacement. Towers remain untouched.
        const old=environmentModels[key];environmentModels[key]=replacement;
        if(old)for(const part of old)if(part?.buffer)gl.deleteBuffer(part.buffer);
        ok++;
      }catch(e){errors.push(file.name+': '+(e?.message||'ошибка импорта'));}
   }
   envStatus.textContent='GLB загружено: '+ok+'/'+files.length+(errors.length?' · ошибок: '+errors.length:'');
   envStatus.title=errors.join('\n')||'Модели окружения заменены в памяти браузера. При перезапуске исходный набор восстановится.';
   if(errors.length)console.warn('Рубеж: импорт окружения:',errors);
   sceneryMode='glb';el('sceneryToggle').textContent='Окружение: GLB 3D v10.2';
   envInput.value='';
 });


 // v8.4: progressive mechanical upgrade modules. The approved GLB v8.1 meshes
 // remain unmodified; added geometry is GPU-buffered by type, upgrade step,
 // and articulation group (fixed / rotating / weapon). No stat changes.
 // Four component shapes: bevel-like plate stacks, short armored sleeves,
 // bolts and ring collars, and cylindrical instrument pods. All local +X forward.
 const UPGRADE_COLORS={
  mg:[.56,.56,.31],gun:[.71,.46,.31],aa:[.34,.53,.66],flame:[.78,.49,.30],
  frost:[.48,.75,.83],eng:[.40,.58,.41],mine:[.74,.63,.29],emp:[.56,.47,.70],radar:[.38,.68,.62]
 };
 function makeUpgrades(type){
  const palette=UPGRADE_COLORS[type]||[.5,.55,.53];
  const layers=Array.from({length:5},()=>[[],[],[]]);
  function rgb(k,offset=0){return palette.map(v=>Math.max(.08,Math.min(.95,v*k+offset)));}
  function tri(arr,a,b,c,color){for(const v of [a,b,c])arr.push(v[0],v[1],v[2],color[0],color[1],color[2]);}
  function quad(arr,a,b,c,d,color){tri(arr,a,b,c,color);tri(arr,a,c,d,color);}
  function box(step,group,x,y,z,wx,wy,wz,k=1){
   const a=layers[step][group],c=rgb(k),top=rgb(k*1.18),side=rgb(k*.75);
   const x0=x-wx/2,x1=x+wx/2,y0=y-wy/2,y1=y+wy/2,z0=z-wz/2,z1=z+wz/2;
   quad(a,[x0,y0,z1],[x1,y0,z1],[x1,y1,z1],[x0,y1,z1],top);
   quad(a,[x0,y1,z0],[x1,y1,z0],[x1,y0,z0],[x0,y0,z0],side);
   quad(a,[x1,y0,z0],[x1,y1,z0],[x1,y1,z1],[x1,y0,z1],c);
   quad(a,[x0,y1,z0],[x0,y0,z0],[x0,y0,z1],[x0,y1,z1],side);
   quad(a,[x0,y1,z0],[x1,y1,z0],[x1,y1,z1],[x0,y1,z1],c);
   quad(a,[x1,y0,z0],[x0,y0,z0],[x0,y0,z1],[x1,y0,z1],rgb(k*.88));
  }
  function tube(step,group,x,y,z,len,r,axis='x',k=1,n=10){
   const a=layers[step][group],ends=[];
   for(let cap of [-.5,.5]){
    const ring=[];
    for(let i=0;i<n;i++){
     const t=i*2*Math.PI/n;
     const q=[x,y,z],j=axis==='x'?0:axis==='y'?1:2,u=(j+1)%3,v=(j+2)%3;
     q[j]+=cap*len;q[u]+=Math.cos(t)*r;q[v]+=Math.sin(t)*r;
     ring.push(q);
    }
    ends.push(ring);
   }
   for(let i=0;i<n;i++){
    const j=(i+1)%n;
    quad(a,ends[0][i],ends[0][j],ends[1][j],ends[1][i],rgb(k*(.83+.24*Math.max(0,Math.sin(i*2*Math.PI/n)))));
    const centerA=[x,y,z],centerB=[x,y,z];let ix=axis==='x'?0:axis==='y'?1:2;
    centerA[ix]-=len/2;centerB[ix]+=len/2;
    tri(a,centerA,ends[0][j],ends[0][i],rgb(k*.67));
    tri(a,centerB,ends[1][i],ends[1][j],rgb(k*1.17));
   }
  }
  function mirrored(step,group,ys,fn){for(const sign of [-1,1])fn(sign*ys,sign);}
  // Stage 2: reinforced base plates and anchoring hardware. Stationary.
  for(const sign of [-1,1]){
   box(0,0,.04,sign*.48,.20,.76,.12,.23,.78);
   for(const x of [-.27,.29])tube(0,0,x,sign*.52,.30,.12,.055,'z',1.25,8);
  }
  box(0,1,-.30,0,.80,.22,.70,.10,.94);
  // Stage 3: a per-type weapon/equipment package (rotating with turret).
  if(type==='mg'){
   mirrored(1,1,.43,(y)=>{box(1,1,.20,y,1.25,.48,.18,.28,.93);tube(1,2,1.07,y*.62,1.12,.92,.072,'x',1.24,12);});
  }else if(type==='gun'){
   tube(1,2,1.19,0,1.30,.95,.15,'x',.83,14);
   tube(1,2,1.56,0,1.30,.17,.22,'x',1.1,14);
  }else if(type==='aa'){
   mirrored(1,2,.49,(y)=>{box(1,2,.35,y,1.49,.87,.30,.33,.96);tube(1,2,.95,y,1.49,.25,.13,'x',.78,10);});
  }else if(type==='flame'){
   mirrored(1,1,.42,(y)=>tube(1,1,-.22,y,1.24,.61,.21,'z',.94,12));
   tube(1,2,1.02,0,1.38,.40,.16,'x',1.14,12);
  }else if(type==='frost'){
   mirrored(1,1,.39,(y)=>tube(1,1,-.25,y,1.15,.61,.17,'z',1.12,12));
   tube(1,2,.69,0,1.52,.37,.21,'x',1.30,12);
  }else if(type==='eng'){
   tube(1,1,-.13,-.52,1.48,.70,.11,'z',1.18,10);
   box(1,1,.21,-.50,1.74,.54,.15,.17,1.05);
  }else if(type==='mine'){
   mirrored(1,1,.42,(y)=>{box(1,1,.19,y,1.22,.64,.26,.26,.88);tube(1,1,.24,y,1.40,.22,.13,'z',1.20,10);});
  }else if(type==='emp'){
   mirrored(1,1,.37,(y)=>tube(1,1,.22,y,1.46,.66,.17,'z',1.28,12));
  }else if(type==='radar'){
   box(1,1,.13,0,2.32,.16,.86,.12,1.14);
   mirrored(1,1,.39,(y)=>tube(1,1,.10,y,2.38,.30,.055,'z',1.24,8));
  }
  // Stage 4: substantial side shields, new cooling/power routing. Rotating.
  mirrored(2,1,.55,(y,sign)=>{
   box(2,1,-.10,y,1.06,.69,.15,.37,.70);
   box(2,1,.12,y,1.23,.40,.18,.12,1.14);
   for(const x of [-.27,.23])tube(2,1,x,y+sign*.09,1.03,.12,.058,'y',1.22,8);
  });
  if(type==='radar'){box(2,1,.12,0,2.57,.17,1.10,.14,.94);}
  if(type==='aa'){mirrored(2,2,.55,(y)=>tube(2,2,.29,y,1.69,.60,.10,'x',1.24,10));}
  if(type==='emp'){tube(2,1,0,0,1.64,.23,.38,'z',1.22,14);}
  // Stage 5: advanced sensors, reinforced power system and mechanisms.
  for(const sign of [-1,1]){
   box(3,0,-.30,sign*.34,.42,.35,.22,.19,.68);
   tube(3,1,-.26,sign*.38,1.63,.32,.10,'z',1.27,10);
   box(3,1,-.13,sign*.38,1.85,.26,.15,.09,1.28);
  }
  if(type==='mg'||type==='gun'){
   tube(3,2,.68,0,1.24,.27,.23,'x',.81,14);
  }else if(type==='flame'){
   tube(3,1,-.32,0,1.69,.56,.20,'z',.86,12);
  }else if(type==='mine'){
   box(3,1,-.14,0,1.91,.51,.62,.22,.88);
  }else if(type==='frost'){
   tube(3,1,0,0,1.77,.23,.33,'z',1.25,14);
  }else if(type==='radar'){
   box(3,1,-.18,0,2.71,.22,.80,.16,1.35);
  }
  // Stage 6: final heavy armor and turret-specific signature hardware.
  mirrored(4,1,.57,(y,sign)=>{
   box(4,1,-.02,y,1.31,.80,.15,.34,.82);
   box(4,1,.18,y,1.49,.45,.12,.10,1.28);
   tube(4,1,-.37,y,1.36,.23,.085,'z',1.33,10);
  });
  if(type==='mg'){
   for(const y of [-.20,.20])tube(4,2,1.22,y,1.20,.68,.090,'x',1.29,12);
   box(4,1,-.12,0,1.91,.46,.46,.16,.98);
  }else if(type==='gun'){
   tube(4,2,1.55,0,1.33,.42,.26,'x',1.16,16);
   box(4,1,-.34,0,1.84,.55,.48,.17,.88);
  }else if(type==='aa'){
   mirrored(4,2,.51,(y)=>tube(4,2,.72,y,1.67,.74,.17,'x',1.26,12));
  }else if(type==='flame'){
   tube(4,2,1.25,0,1.45,.40,.22,'x',1.34,12);
   mirrored(4,1,.31,(y)=>tube(4,1,-.25,y,1.55,.58,.24,'z',.95,12));
  }else if(type==='frost'){
   tube(4,1,0,0,1.95,.48,.34,'z',1.35,16);
   mirrored(4,2,.22,(y)=>tube(4,2,.57,y,1.58,.32,.09,'x',1.25,10));
  }else if(type==='eng'){
   tube(4,1,-.22,.53,1.60,.75,.15,'z',1.24,12);
   box(4,1,.10,.52,1.95,.57,.20,.19,1.12);
  }else if(type==='mine'){
   for(const y of [-.35,0,.35])tube(4,1,.46,y,1.51,.42,.16,'x',1.13,12);
  }else if(type==='emp'){
   mirrored(4,1,.38,(y)=>tube(4,1,.05,y,1.74,.85,.20,'z',1.31,12));
   tube(4,1,0,0,2.02,.25,.23,'z',1.40,14);
  }else if(type==='radar'){
   box(4,1,.14,0,2.80,.13,1.18,.23,1.31);
   for(const y of [-.48,.48])tube(4,1,.13,y,2.79,.54,.07,'z',1.37,10);
  }
  return layers.map(groups=>groups.map(data=>{
   if(!data.length)return null;
   const buffer=gl.createBuffer();gl.bindBuffer(gl.ARRAY_BUFFER,buffer);
   gl.bufferData(gl.ARRAY_BUFFER,new Float32Array(data),gl.STATIC_DRAW);
   return {buffer,count:data.length/6,legacy:true};
  }));
 }
 const visualUpgrades=Object.fromEntries(Object.keys(models).map(type=>[type,makeUpgrades(type)]));
 const EMBEDDED_PAINTED_ATLASES={"mg":"
